description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Line' that extends another class for creating smoothed Bezier line charts with features for rendering the chart, handling dataset points, and drawing legends. It is part of a graph rendering utility, specifically in the plotting section for smoothed lines.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Line
classes.description: A class for rendering smoothed Bezier line charts with support for curves and custom styling, extending the base smoothed Bezier plot class.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Returns the transparent fill style for the plot.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the line for the chart legend.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the drawing of the smoothed line chart, handling datasets, control points, splines, and rendering groups.
